Assessment.description:
A run's grade with the numbers behind it.

Attributes:
    grade: One of the five grades.
    label: The grade's display name.
    next_step: One sentence: what the evidence supports and what would settle the question.
    blocking: The non-green gates that keep the run from the next grade up, in gate order.
    sharpe_upper_95: `(hac_t + 1.645) / sqrt(years)`; `None` without a `hac_t` value.
    years: Years of data the significance tests ran on.
    years_needed: Years at the observed Sharpe for the t-statistic to reach `min_hac_t`;
        `None` unless the Sharpe is positive.
    legacy_label: The three-label verdict this grade maps to.
Assessment.title: Assessment

BetRow.description:
One settled prediction-market bet.

Attributes:
    entry_ts: When the position was opened (ISO 8601), or `None` if not recorded.
    settled_ts: When the market resolved (ISO 8601).
    symbol: The market id.
    side: `"yes"` or `"no"`, from the sign of the settled position.
    stake: Capital committed at entry, in the base currency.
    market_price: The Yes-equivalent entry price.
    forecast: The model's Yes probability at entry.
    outcome: `1.0` if Yes resolved true, else `0.0`.
    pnl: Realised P&L net of fees.
    book_source: `"real"` (venue's quoted book) or `"synthetic"` (modelled from trade bars) for
        the entry fill; `None` if it cannot be traced to a fill.
BetRow.title: BetRow

BookFillSummary.description:
How a prediction-market book's fills split between a real and a modelled order book.

Attributes:
    by_source: Filled or partially filled order count per `book_source`.
    total: Sum of `by_source`'s values.
    real: Fills booked against a real order book.
    label: One sentence summarising the split; says plainly when every fill was synthetic.
BookFillSummary.title: BookFillSummary

CalibrationBin.description:
One bin of a prediction-market reliability diagram (settled bets by model forecast).

Attributes:
    lo: Lower forecast edge.
    hi: Upper forecast edge.
    n: Settled bets in the bin.
    mean_forecast: Mean model forecast of those bets.
    mean_market_price: Mean Yes-equivalent entry price.
    outcome_rate: Share whose market resolved Yes.
CalibrationBin.title: CalibrationBin

Caveat.description:
One stated limit of a run.

Attributes:
    id: Stable identifier of the rule.
    text: One or two plain sentences stating the limit and the figures behind it.
Caveat.title: Caveat

ChargedCosts.description:
The cost rates one instrument was charged and the section they came from.

Attributes:
    kind: The instrument's kind.
    section: `"kind"` when the instrument was charged its kind's rates, else the cost section:
        `"etf"`, `"futures_roots"`, `"fx_pairs"`, `"crypto_pairs"` or `"options"`.
    key: The section key the instrument resolved to (after aliases); `None` for the kind.
    commission_bps: Commission, in bps of notional.
    half_spread_bps: Half spread, in bps of notional.
    slippage_bps: Slippage, in bps of notional.
    exchange_fee_bps: Exchange fee, in bps of notional.
    commission_per_contract: Commission per contract and side, in the contract's currency.
    half_spread_per_contract_usd: Half spread per contract and side, in USD; futures sections.
    slippage_per_contract_usd: Slippage per contract and side, in USD; futures sections.
    exchange_fee_per_contract_usd: Exchange and regulatory fees per contract and side, in USD;
        futures and options sections.
    spread_fraction_paid: Fraction of the quoted spread an option order pays; options
        sections.
ChargedCosts.title: ChargedCosts

ClaimRow.description:
One claimed figure next to edgelab's.

Attributes:
    metric: The figure.
    paper_value: As printed in the paper.
    paper_se: The paper's standard error, if printed.
    edgelab_value: edgelab's figure under the paper's conventions; `None` if not computable.
    diff: `edgelab_value - paper_value`.
    rel_diff: `diff / |paper_value|`; `None` when the paper value is zero.
    within_tolerance: Whether `diff` lies inside the claim's stated tolerance.
    status: `"match"` inside tolerance, `"differ"` outside, `"not_comparable"` when edgelab
        could not produce the figure or the run does not cover the paper's sample.
    note: The claim's note, plus the reason when not comparable.
ClaimRow.title: ClaimRow

ClientRef.description:
The client project and revision a submission comes from.

Attributes:
    project: Plain project name, lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
    git_sha: Commit of the client repository the strategy code was taken from (7 to 40 hex
        characters).
    hypothesis_id: The client's identifier of the hypothesis under test.

project.description: Client project name: lower-case letters, digits, hyphens.
project.title: Project

ClientRef.title: ClientRef

ConclusionRow.description:
The paper's conclusion next to edgelab's verdict, mapped to the same three labels.

Attributes:
    paper: The paper's conclusion.
    edgelab: edgelab's verdict mapped to `edge` / `no_edge` / `mixed`.
    edgelab_overall: The verdict label as edgelab printed it.
    agree: Whether the two labels coincide.
ConclusionRow.title: ConclusionRow

CostBreakdownRow.description:
One cost component's total, mirroring `edgelab.engine.result.CostBreakdownItem`.

Attributes:
    component: Cost component name (e.g. `"commission"`, `"spread"`, `"impact"`).
    currency: Total cost of this component over the run, in the base currency.
    bps: Total cost of this component in basis points of average NAV.
CostBreakdownRow.title: CostBreakdownRow

DataProvenance.description:
Data vintage and provenance caveats a reader should check before trusting the numbers.

Attributes:
    lake_freshness: The audit's `lake_freshness` detail (each lakehouse table's last write and
        coverage end), or `"not recorded"`.
    lake_freshness_ok: Whether every table the lake reports was fresh.
    truncated_futures_roots: Futures roots truncated to the available front-month history; empty
        if none.
    survivorship_coverage: Fraction of an index universe's ex-members with price history through
        their removal, or `None` if not applicable or not recorded.
    adjustment_verification: The audit's detail on tickers whose split/dividend adjustment
        factors are unverified or absent, or `"not recorded"`.
    adjustment_verification_ok: Whether every ticker's adjustment factors are verified.
    unexplained_ends: Held positions closed at their last traded close with no delisting row.
DataProvenance.title: DataProvenance

DateWindow.description:
A closed date range, `start <= end`.

Attributes:
    start: First day.
    end: Last day, inclusive.
DateWindow.title: DateWindow

EventTotal.description:
Count and net cash flow of one event kind over the run.

Attributes:
    event: The event kind, e.g. `"funding"` or `"option_expiry"`.
    count: Number of events.
    cash: Sum of the events' signed cash flows, in the base currency.
EventTotal.title: EventTotal

EvidenceGroup.description:
One of the six questions the verdict gates answer.

Attributes:
    key: Stable identifier, e.g. `"significance"`.
    question: The question, e.g. "Is it statistically significant?".
    status: `red` if any gate is red, else `amber` if any is amber, else `green` if any is
        green,
        else `not_evaluated`.
    headline_label: Label of the group's key figure.
    headline_value: The key figure, or `None` if its gate was not evaluated.
    headline_unit: Unit of the key figure.
    gates: The gates in the group, with their explanations.
EvidenceGroup.title: EvidenceGroup

FamilyEvaluationsModel.description:
The multiple-testing disclosure plus what each counted hypothesis was evaluated under.

The summary's multiple-testing block: the scorecard's disclosure with the family stage's
record of repeated evaluations.

Attributes:
    measurement_versions: Per counted hypothesis, keyed by hypothesis key, the name of every
        measurement (published grading policy or custom grading block) it was evaluated
        under. A hypothesis counts once for all its published policies and once more per
        custom measurement.
    data_snapshots: Per the same hypotheses, every data snapshot id it was evaluated on.
    reported_hypothesis: The key of the hypothesis the run reports, or `None`.
FamilyEvaluationsModel.title: FamilyEvaluationsModel

GroupRow.description:
The settled bets (else closed round trips) of one group of a submission's groups file.

Attributes:
    group: The group name, or `UNGROUPED`.
    n: Settled bets, or closed round trips for a book without bets.
    pnl: Their summed net P&L.
    mean_return: Mean P&L per unit staked for bets, or mean round-trip return; `None` when
        undefined.
    hit_rate: Share with positive P&L; `None` when undefined.
GroupRow.title: GroupRow

HeadlineRow.description:
One measurement, for the strategy and (where it applies) the benchmark.

Attributes:
    key: Stable identifier, e.g. `"cagr"`.
    label: Display label.
    unit: How to format the values.
    strategy: The strategy's value, or `None` if undefined on this sample.
    benchmark: The benchmark's value, or `None` if none or not applicable (e.g. trade counts).
    difference: `strategy - benchmark` where both exist and it is meaningful.
HeadlineRow.title: HeadlineRow

LeadBlock.description:
The lead of a result, items in reading order.

Attributes:
    effect: `estimate`, `ci_low`, `ci_high` of the primary metric on the test window.
    detectability: `mde`, `sample_needed`, `years_needed`.
    costs: Breakeven multiple and gross against net (betting: margin paid).
    risk: Maximum drawdown and its length, worst month, CVaR 1%.
    stability: Sign by third, leave-one-group-out, top contributors' share.
    capacity: Capacity where measured.
    counts: N used, counted, declared, effective, whether declared N was verified, and the
        rung at N = 1 and at the N used.
    holdout: The holdout state.
    caveats: Caveats shown with the result.
    not_measured: What was not measured.
LeadBlock.title: LeadBlock

PriorExposure.description:
Earlier looks of this strategy family at the data, which the trial count did not see.

Attributes:
    note: What the earlier looks were.
    windows: The date windows the earlier runs of this family (its variants) were evaluated on.
    min_count: The known lower bound of those uncounted earlier runs.
PriorExposure.title: PriorExposure

ReplayBlock.description:
What a decision-file replay reports besides its P&L.

Attributes:
    status_shares: Per instrument, the share of its rows in each `status` (`active`,
        `unavailable`, `error`; a row without a status is `active`).
    non_session_decision_dates: Decision dates that are not sessions of the calendar; never
        traded.
    missing_fill_bars: `(decision date, instrument)` pairs with a nonzero target and no bar on
        the next session; never filled.
    label: How the replay was graded (`REPLAY_LABEL`).

label.default: graded from recorded decisions; look-ahead checked on declared source times
label.title: Label

ReplayBlock.title: ReplayBlock

ReplicationReport.description:
The full comparison for one paper against one run.

Attributes:
    source_title: The paper's title.
    source_table: Which table the claims came from.
    rows: One row per claim, in the spec's order.
    conclusion: The conclusion comparison.
    n_match: Rows with status `"match"`.
    n_differ: Rows with status `"differ"`.
    n_not_comparable: Rows with status `"not_comparable"`.
    sample_covered: Whether the run's returns span the paper's sample window.
    notes: The replication spec's notes.
ReplicationReport.title: ReplicationReport

RunMeta.description:
What was run, on what, with what.

Attributes:
    schema_version: Version of the summary layout, `SUMMARY_SCHEMA_VERSION` for a run saved now;
        0 for a summary saved without the field.
    bars_per_year: Bars in a year on the strategy's schedule.
    asset_class: The book's primary asset class (first kind of a mixed book).
    benchmark: Human-readable benchmark description, or `None`.
    universe: The traded symbols (empty for index or filter universes).
    live_start: First bar the strategy was invested or eligible to be (after warm-up).
    live_end: Last bar of the evaluated period.
    n_bars: Number of live bars.
    holdout_start: Close of the locked holdout's first bar (ISO 8601, UTC), from
        `edgelab.validation.holdout.search_range_for`; every bar of the run closes before it.
        `None` when the data range holds no holdout bar. A summary saved before it was
        recorded may hold a date.
    holdout_evaluated: Whether this run evaluated the holdout: true only when the holdout was
        unlocked and produced a result, false for a locked holdout.
    edgelab_sha: HEAD commit of the edgelab checkout the run executed from (`"unknown"`
        outside a git checkout); `None` for a summary saved without it.
    client: The client project, commit and hypothesis of a submission run; `None` for a
        library run.
    seed: The seed of every stochastic step of the run; `None` for a summary saved without it.
    lake_time: The lake state the run read, as a UTC timestamp; `None` when no lake was read.
    lake_version: The lake version the run read (`X-Lakehouse-Version` as received); `None`
        when no lake was read.
    lake_current_tables: The tables the run read without a log, at the lake version rather
        than at `lake_time`; `None` when no lake was read.
    train_end: The last date the client used to design or fit the strategy, as declared;
        `None` when not declared.
    test_window: The window the client declared the evidence is scored on, as declared;
        `None` when not declared.
    edgelab_dirty: Whether tracked edgelab sources differed from `edgelab_sha`; `None` if
        unknown or not recorded.
    strategy_dirty: Whether the strategy folder's defining files were untracked or differed
        from HEAD; `None` if unknown or not recorded.
    strategy_files_sha256: Hash of the strategy folder's defining files; `None` if not recorded.
    provenance: `"committed"` when both dirty flags are false, `"uncommitted code"` when
        either is true, `"unknown"` when either is unknown; `None` if not recorded. Only a
        committed run counts as a grade.
    profile: Sample-size profile the run used, when known.
    overall: The three-label verdict (the assessment's `legacy_label` when there is one).
    costs: One line describing the transaction costs charged.
    cost_rates_charged: For a strategy-class run, the rates each traded instrument was charged
        and the cost section they came from, by instrument id; `None` for a summary saved
        without it.
    cost_table_sha256: The registered sha256 of the cost table the grading block's policy
        carries; `None` when the measurement carries no table.
    setup: How the strategy trades.
    strategy_class: For a strategy-class run, `StrategyConfig.strategy`; else `None`.
    strategy_fields: For a strategy-class run, `(field name, JSON value)` for every value the
        class was instantiated with, sorted by name; else `None`.
    grading_policy_version: For a strategy-class run, the measurement the `grading:` block is:
        a published policy version, or `custom:<digest>` when it equals none (the name the
        ledger records); else `None`.
    grading_diffs: For a strategy-class run, one line per value differing from the published
        version above (for a custom block, the newest published version), e.g.
        `"gates.min_psr: 0.95 -> 0.9"`; empty if equal; else `None`.
    grading_custom_fields: For a custom grading block, the dotted paths of the fields that
        differ from the newest published version (e.g. `gates.min_psr`); empty otherwise.
    data_fit_note: For a strategy-class run, the data-fit gate's disclosure of the weakest
        annual
        Sharpe the history and trial count could confirm; else `None`.
    live_validation: Whether the run made the live-validation checks; when `False`, CPCV,
        walk-forward, the random-entry placebo and the re-running robustness checks are
        reported as "not run: live validation off".
    evidence_basis: `"stated_hypothesis"` for a run whose figures were measured on the basis
        the pipeline now uses (a pre-stated hypothesis, risk-free-adjusted Sharpe, versioned
        measurements); `None` for a run saved before that, which the library calls an earlier
        run.
RunMeta.title: RunMeta

RunSeries.description:
Chart data, aligned on the live bars.

Attributes:
    ts: Bar-close timestamps (ISO 8601, UTC).
    strategy_growth: Growth of 1 invested at the start of the live period.
    benchmark_growth: The same for the benchmark, or `None`.
    strategy_drawdown: Drawdown from the running peak, as a positive fraction.
    benchmark_drawdown: The same for the benchmark, or `None`.
    rolling_sharpe: Rolling annualised Sharpe over `rolling_window_bars`; `None` until full.
    rolling_window_bars: Window length, three years of bars.
    rolling_excess_return: Rolling annualised mean excess over the benchmark; `None` until full
        and without a benchmark.
    annual: `{"year", "strategy", "benchmark"}` calendar-year returns.
    monthly: `{"year", "month", "strategy", "benchmark"}` calendar-month returns.
    decades: `{"decade", "strategy_cagr", "benchmark_cagr", "difference", "n_bars"}` per decade
        (its first year), partial decades included.
RunSeries.title: RunSeries

RunSetup.description:
How the strategy trades: bar length, rebalance cadence, execution, sizing and signal.

Attributes:
    bar: Bar length in words, e.g. `"Monthly"`.
    rebalance: How often positions are re-evaluated and traded.
    order_type: `"market"` or `"limit"`.
    fill_rule: `"next_open"`, `"next_close"` or `"vwap_proxy"`.
    lag_bars: Bars between the decision bar and the earliest fill bar.
    execution: One sentence combining the three fields above.
    sizing: Sizing rule kind, e.g. `"equal_weight"`.
    signal: The signal's registered name or `path.py:function` reference.
    universe: One line describing the universe, e.g. "10 fixed symbols".
    instrument: The instrument kind(s) traded, e.g. `"mixed: equity, option"`.
    fills_at_decision_close_share: Of the reported trial's `signal` fills, the share whose
        price before costs equals the instrument's close on the decision bar (relative
        tolerance 1e-12). A share of 1 means no fill took a price later than the decision.
        `None` when there is no such fill, the instrument kind has no bars (prediction
        markets), or the run did not record it.
RunSetup.title: RunSetup

Rung.description:
A graded rung.

Attributes:
    level: The rung.
    label: For L1 only: `no_edge`, `inconclusive` or `diagnostic`; otherwise `None`.
    reasons: Why the rung is what it is, one string per cause.
    years_needed: On L1, the years the primary test needs at the observed effect.
    red_flags: Names of the flags whose status is `red`.
Rung.title: Rung

ScoreWindow.description:
The window the evidence is scored on, `start < end`.

Attributes:
    start: First day.
    end: Last day, strictly after `start`.
ScoreWindow.title: ScoreWindow

SummaryTables.description:
The full tables the inline previews are cut from; the tables are authoritative.

Attributes:
    trades: Every closed round trip, with the columns of `RunSummary.trades_preview`.
    bets: Every settled bet, with the columns of `BetRow`; 0 rows without bets.
SummaryTables.title: SummaryTables

TableRef.description:
A table stored beside `summary.json` as a Parquet file.

Attributes:
    path: The file, relative to the run folder.
    rows: The file's row count.
    sha256: The file's SHA-256 hash.
TableRef.title: TableRef

TradeSummary.description:
Statistics of the closed round trips of the best trial.

A round trip's return is its net P&L as a fraction of NAV at the entry bar. The round trips
themselves are in `RunSummary.trades_preview` (the newest 500) and in the trades table.

Attributes:
    n_round_trips: Number of closed round trips.
    win_rate: Share with positive net P&L.
    avg_return: Mean round-trip return, as a fraction of NAV at entry.
    best_return: Largest round-trip return.
    worst_return: Smallest round-trip return.
    avg_bars_held: Mean holding period, in bars.
TradeSummary.title: TradeSummary

TrialsBlock.description:
The trial count the run was judged with and what the client declared.

Attributes:
    edgelab_n: The N the Deflated Sharpe Ratio used, or edgelab's own count when the client's
        declared N was larger and set the DSR's N.
    declared_family: The client's trial family name; `None` for a library run.
    declared_n: The client's declared N; `None` for a library run.
    ledger_ref: The client's ledger reference, as given.
    declared_status: `"declared_unverified"` for a submission's declaration, `"none"` for a
        library run. An overlap of the test window with a declared prior-exposure window keeps
        it `"declared_unverified"`.
    test_keys: The client's test keys, as given.
    ledger_export_path: The client's ledger export path, as given.
    prior_exposure: The earlier looks at the data the client declared, as given.
    exposure_overlap: Whether `[meta.live_start, meta.live_end]` shares at least one day
        (ends inclusive) with a declared prior-exposure window. Only this strategy family's
        own declared exposure counts.
TrialsBlock.title: TrialsBlock

description:
Everything the terminal view and the strategy report need for one run.

Attributes:
    meta: What was run.
    rung: The graded rung; `None` for a summary saved before the rung.
    lead: The lead block (the eight items, caveats and what was not measured); `None` for a
        summary saved before the rung.
    headline: The measurement table.
    class_metrics: Asset-class measurements of a non-equity book (empty for equity).
    calibration: The reliability diagram of a prediction-market book (else empty).
    bets_preview: The newest 500 settled bets of a prediction-market book (else empty), for
        the viewer. The bets table is authoritative; its total is `tables.bets.rows`.
    book_fills: Real-versus-modelled book split for prediction markets, else `None`.
    events: Count and cash per discrete event kind.
    evidence: The six evidence questions.
    series: Chart data.
    trades: Round-trip statistics.
    trades_preview: The newest 500 closed round trips (`symbol`, `side`, `entry_ts`,
        `exit_ts`, `return`, `bars_held`), newest first, for the viewer. The trades table is
        authoritative; its total is `tables.trades.rows`.
    trials: The trial count the run used and the client's declaration; `None` for a summary
        saved before schema 3.
    replay: Status shares and gap counts of a decision-file replay; `None` for any other run.
    tables: The full trades and bets tables; `None` for a summary saved without them.
    groups: Results per group of a submission's groups file; empty without one.
    costs: Cost components in currency and in bps of average NAV.
    robustness: The cost and delay sweeps and robustness scalars, as the stage wrote them.
    validation: CPCV and random-entry distributions and the holdout fields.
    attribution: Factor-regression result.
    capacity: Capacity result.
    multiple_testing: How many trials the family counts, how they were chosen, and which
        measurement versions and data snapshots each counted hypothesis was evaluated under.
    metrics: Every registered metric's value (`def_name`, `group`, `estimate`, `reason`).
    diagnostics: Return-distribution diagnosis.
    replication: The paper-versus-edgelab table, when the spec names a paper.
    provenance: Data and code provenance.
    data_provenance: Data vintage and quality caveats.
    caveats: The limits of the model the run was produced under; they change no gate.
    assessment: The run's five-grade assessment; `None` for a run saved without one.
title: RunSummary
